units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite> (vers. in Ar.) <he>חד ס׳ ולא גנב וכ׳</he> when one is weak and steals no longer &c.; v. <cite ref="C01083"><he>גַּנָבָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. סָרַח III) to decay, be spoiled; to smell offensively.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 7:18">Targ. Ex. VII, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 7:21">21</cite> (h. text <he>באש</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:12">Targ. Cant. I, 12</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:22">Targ. Prov. XI, 22</cite> <he>וסָרֵי טעמא</he> (read: <he>טַעֲמָהּ</he>) her sense is vapid (h. text <he>סרת טעם</he>; Pesh. <he>סַרְיַית</he>; cmp. <he>דעה סרוחה</he>, s. v. <cite ref="O01573"><he>סָרַח</he> III</cite>).—
<cite ref="Sukkah 12b">Succ. 12ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>כיון דסרי ריחייהו</he> because their odor becomes offensive (when they wither).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:13">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>מיסרח סרי</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>מיסר׳ סרי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it (the honey) would be spoiled (become running through an admixture).

Bekh. 8ᵇ מילחא כי ס׳ וכ׳ when salt has lost its savor, wherewith can it be salted? Ned. 50ᵇ אזלת … וס׳ she went and put the wine into gold and silver vessels, and it became stale; Taan. 7ᵃ תקוף ואיסר Ms. M. (read: ואִיסְּרֵי, Ithpe.; ed. only ותקיף) it became sour and stale.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 29:6">Targ. Ps. XXIX, 6</cite> <he>טור מַסְרֵי פירוי</he> ‘the mount which produces tasteless fruits’ (h. text <cite ref="U01967"><he>שריון</he></cite>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 3:9">Targ. Y. I Deut. III, 9</cite> (Y. II <he>ארעא</he> read <cite ref="I00215"><he>טורא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 5:23">Targ. I Chr. V, 23</cite> <he>מסרי פירוי</he> (in one w.) ed. Rahmer (Var. <he>מישרי פרזי</he>; ed. Lag. <he>מישר פרזי</he>, read: <he>מַשֵּׁיר פרוי</he> that drops its fruit; h. text <cite ref="U01598"><he>שניר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:12">Targ. Cant. I, 12</cite> <he>אַסְרִיאוּ עובדיהון</he> they made their deeds unsavory.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 10:1">Targ. Koh. X, 1</cite> <he>מַסְרֵי חכימא</he> makes the wise man vapid (stupid, v. <cite ref="O01573"><he>סָרַח</he> III</cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a:4">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא נִסְתְּרֵי עבדיה</he> Ms. R. (ed. <he>לִסְתְּרִיהַּ</he>; Rashi <he>נִסְתְּרִיהַּ</he>) that his slave may not become mischievous (through idleness); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 65a:1">B. Mets. 65ᵃ</cite> top <he>נסתרי</he>.

senses.gloss: to become a nuisance, a cause of corruption.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 5b:10">Sot. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא ליסתריה לביתיה</he> (Tosaf. <he>ליסתרי</he>, Rashi <he>תיסתרי</he>) that she may not become a cause of decay to his house; <cite ref="Sotah 5b:10">ib.</cite> <he>דלא תִסְתְּרֵי</he>.
